name: Using Your Time Wisely
overview: Scripture teaches that our time is sovereignly held by God, who directs our days and purposes, as expressed in Psalms 31:15 and Ecclesiastes 3:1. We are called to wisely number our days to gain understanding and live with purposeful diligence, illustrated by Proverbs 6:6 and Psalms 90:12. Yet, this wisdom includes trusting God’s provision for rest, recognizing that He grants rest to His beloved, as Psalms 127:2 and Proverbs 31:17 reveal.
